## (1) LINE 1 — the cross-host bundler has no production option: FIXED (CONFIRMED)

The required change has five parts. Each is confirmed below.

**(i) The option adds the define and nothing else.** `bundle.ts` now has `buildCrossHostBundles(entryPath, options = {})`.
`{ production: true }` spreads `define: { PLAT_DEBUG_BUILD: 'false' }` into both esbuild calls (node and browser), and
`production` is read as `options.production === true`. The rest of the build options are byte for byte main's.
CONFIRMED by reading the file against main's copy (GitHub API, blob `02e4455752d7…`).

**(ii) API frozen (rule (5)).** The function gains one optional parameter. Its options type is module-private.
`crosshost/index.ts` is unchanged: its git blob hash in the tree is `2872eac6f53b…`, the same as main's (computed here,
no git). No message text changed. C-0472 (2) states this. CONFIRMED.

**(iii) NO-SHIFT, measured against main's file.** The seat put main's `bundle.ts` into its mirror as `bundle-before.ts`
(blob `02e44557…`, the same as main's) and bundled every table with both files (cwd = the mirror root). The default
call (no option, `{}`, `{ production: false }`) was byte-identical to main's in every case. CONFIRMED.

**(iv) The build is observed from inside the leg.** The production browser bundle of `debug-stages.ts` was run in a bare
